_note: The system-defaults semantic-token corpus (OpenSource/Documentation/architecture/proposals/system-defaults.md; desktop columns per proposals/desktop-platforms.md). THE LAW ENCODED HERE: (1) defaults live in the RENDERER — an element with no author styles renders the platform's own system component, and these words select system COLOR SLOTS on it, never authored values. (2) Native columns are ROLE NAMES on purpose: ios/watchos carry the UIColor semantic slot (watchOS resolves the same slots under the wrist's always-dark system appearance), android the Material 3 color role under dynamicColorScheme() (static M3 fallback < API 31), wear the Compose Material for Wear OS role. macos carries the SAME UIColor/SwiftUI semantic slots (the Mac build hosts real system components — Catalyst/AppKit-backed, so inherited looks self-update with the OS). windows/linux carry the android-shaped M3 role names, resolved by the desktop renderer's HONEST-NEUTRAL color scheme — Compose cannot HOST WinUI/GTK controls, and a re-specified system look rots (the iOS-26 lesson), so never fake-Fluent, never fake-Adwaita; real system signals still feed the scheme (both OSes' dark mode; the Windows accent color seeds `primary`). The OS owns what it can own, the neutral scheme owns the rest. (3) Only web carries literal values, because the web has no system palette to inherit: an HONEST neutral skin — `css` is the custom property of the dsx-tokens layer, `light`/`dark` its scheme pair riding `color-scheme: light dark` — emitted as media-query + pin-table scheme twins, never bare light-dark() (the stamped Safari 16.4 browser floor predates it). NEUTRAL grays + a blue accent, never fake-Cupertino (no SF-flavored rgba tables — Ionic's disavowed mistake). (4) Every renderer consumes THIS file (the api-blocks.json shape): the web drift gate is OpenSource/Web/packages/dom/test/theme.test.ts; the Kotlin and Swift/watch consumers land per the spec's migration order; the desktop renderers consume their columns at M1 (Swift/Mac) and D1 (Compose desktop). A vocabulary change here without a spec change is drift — the gates pin the word list.
